source: Terminal output of the timed setup run on the test machine, 2026-11-04 (copied verbatim; the prompt answers are the operator's).
lines: This creates a separate standard (non-admin) Windows account for running
code from recruiters and clients. Code run there cannot read the files in
your own account: SSH keys, cloud logins, browser passwords, wallets.
Windows will ask for permission, then a PowerShell window asks for the new
account's password. The password is not shown, saved or sent anywhere.
Created 'interview' in 30 s. It is a standard user, not an administrator.
